description:
GOAL: Keep rendered-closure behavior fixtures stable when unrelated runtime modules change function allocation order.

SIGNAL: Fixture comparisons retain the rendered #fn form and arity, but never make raw denotation mint IDs contractual; File can add its runtime module without unrelated closure golden churn.

STRATEGY: Canonicalize numeric #fn denotations in matrix output before comparison, test the normalization, document the contract, and express the closure fixture golden with the canonical identity.
title: Canonicalize non-contract closure identities in fixture output
